Class ControlFlowTck

java.lang.Object
io.micronaut.sourcegen.bytecode.tck.AbstractByteCodeWriterTck
io.micronaut.sourcegen.bytecode.tck.ControlFlowTck
public abstract class ControlFlowTck extends AbstractByteCodeWriterTck
Loops, switches, try, catch and finally, and the statements that complete them, compared with what javac writes for the same source.

A backend runs these tests by extending this class and implementing AbstractByteCodeWriterTck.write(io.micronaut.sourcegen.model.ObjectDef).

Since:
2.3
